title: Cover reload after reconciled or compensated Codex child archive
outcome: Behavioral reload coverage protects durable automatic archive ownership after archived-inventory reconciliation and compensation re-archive, alongside direct successful archive coverage.
acceptance: A behavioral test drives an ambiguous or rejected automatic archive reply through positive archived-inventory reconciliation, reloads persisted SQLite state and successfully follows up through automatic unarchive.
A behavioral test verifies that a confirmed compensation re-archive retains the correct thread/home ownership across reload without transferring ownership to a manual or replaced thread.
